Fixed version -- People with red-green color blindness should be able to see this because the red and green parts have different brightness. As you can see, it reads, "FUCK THE COLOR BLIND".

I made this by decomposing the image into YCbCr. Then, I exaggerated and inverted the contrast of the Cr plane (basically, the redness of the image) and mixed that with the original Y (brightness) plane. Finally, I converted the whole thing back into RGB. So the color information is unchanged, but the brightness is a mix of the original brightness and some of the color information, making the red areas darker and the green area lighter.
